The '''''Valiant''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] during the [[First Jedi Purge]]. In [[3951 BBY]] it was captained by [[Opelle]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Valiant'' and its captain were part of a subplot in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' involving the hostile takeover of [[Citadel Station]] by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] that was ultimately cut from the game. However, a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] at the [[Telos Security Force]] offices refers to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Carth Onasi]]'s ship as the ''Valiant'' in conversation (in contrast with the subtitles and the rest of the game, which call it the [[Sojourn (Hammerhead-class)|''Sojourn'']]).
